integrity: Analytic four-group kernel proof, binomial counts, and reproducible standard-library verifier; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact single omitted triple and ideal pure-state model only; no Pauli sign distribution, multi-defect classification, error robustness, or computational advantage established. Scalar m2 follows from a prior random-retention moment by differentiation, so only the complete rank/amplitude histogram and all-order consequences are claimed as new.
title: Complete Pauli-magnitude spectrum of a single-edge-defective dense CCZ state
